name: Adventure Day Camp
street_address: Ballantine Park Pavilion, 611 Old Field Road
description_short: A town day camp at the Ballantine Park pavilion in Southbury, weekdays 8:30 am to 4 pm in weekly sessions from July 6 to August 14. Campers are grouped by grade, play sports and games, do art, have a weekly swim lesson and camper only pool time, meet entertainers on Tuesdays and take a field trip most Thursdays.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund for cancellations before registration closes (the Friday two weeks before the camp week); 25% fee after that; 50% fee within seven days of the week's start. No refunds for dismissals.
swim_waterfront_notes: Each week includes a swim lesson and pool time reserved for campers at the Ballantine Park pool, weather permitting; none on field trip days.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 handbook (revised 6/10/26): camp runs Monday to Friday 8:30 am to 4 pm, July 6 to August 14, registered by the week. Before camp 7:30 to 8:30 and after camp 4 to 5:30 at extra cost. Bad weather moves camp to the Parks and Recreation office at 561 Main Street South. Campers bring a bagged lunch. Groups by fall 2026 grade; the handbook gives no grade range or fee.
